settings.title: Organization Settings
settings.noAccess: You don't have access to this page
settings.name: Organization Name
settings.localeHint: Used for receipts, emails, and number formatting
settings.logoHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, or SVG. Max {size}MB.
settings.invoiceAnnualResetDesc: Reset receipt numbering at the start of each year
settings.sepaFormatDesc: ISO 20022 pain.008 — standard for all SEPA-zone banks
settings.genderOptionsDesc: Configure the gender options available in member forms. Each option needs a value key and labels in all languages.

providers.title: Payment Providers
providers.description: Configure payment provider credentials and settings

recurringBilling.title: Recurring billing
recurringBilling.enabledDesc: Automatically generate membership-fee receipts on the configured schedule
recurringBilling.dayDesc: Day (1–31) the billing runs; a shorter month is billed on its last day. Quarterly and annual fees are only billed in the first month of their period.
recurringBilling.dueDaysDesc: Days from issue until a generated fee is due. Payment reminders start counting from that due date.
recurringBilling.notificationEmailDesc: Optional address that receives a summary after each automatic run

paymentReminders.title: Payment reminders
paymentReminders.enabledDesc: Automatically email members about overdue receipts on the configured schedule
paymentReminders.daysAfterDueDesc: Days after the due date before the first reminder is sent
paymentReminders.maxCountDesc: Maximum number of reminders per receipt (1–10)

communications.title: Announcements module
communications.enabledDesc: On: staff get the Communications screen to write and broadcast announcements, and members get the notification bell and their Announcements page. Off: all three disappear and the announcement emails stop. Existing announcements are kept and come back if you switch it on again.
communications.description: Master switch for the announcements feature. It does not affect the member emails below, which keep sending either way.

memberCard.title: Digital Member Card
memberCard.enabledDesc: Give members a digital card with a QR code for check-in.
memberCard.assignNumbers: Assign numbers to members without one

sso.title: Single sign-on (SSO)
sso.description: Let members sign in with Google or Apple. Enter each provider's credentials and switch it on — no redeploy needed.
sso.enableHint: Enable once the credentials are saved.
sso.secretHint: Leave blank to keep the stored value; enter a new one to replace it.
sso.consoleHint: Paste the backend URL and each redirect URI into the Google / Apple developer console.
sso.encryptionKeyMissing: The server could not initialise its encryption key — check that the storage volume is writable. Secret fields cannot be saved until it is.
sso.encryptionKeyRequired: Could not save the secret: the server has no working encryption key.
sso.encryptionActive: Encryption active — secrets are stored encrypted with a server-managed key and are never shown here.

mailing.title: Mail provider
mailing.description: Choose and configure the provider your emails are sent through. Only one can be active at a time.

hints.resend: Managed delivery through the Resend API.
hints.gmail: SMTP delivery with a Gmail account and an app password.

mailing.oneAtATime: Only one provider can be active at a time.
mailing.appPasswordHint: Use a Google app password, not your account password. Leave blank to keep the stored one.
mailing.secretHint: Leave blank to keep the stored value; enter a new one to replace it.
mailing.fillCredsFirst: Fill in the credentials before activating it.
mailing.testNeedsReady: Configure and save the credentials first.
mailing.testNeedsSave: Save your changes before sending the test.
mailing.providerNotReady: Credentials for that provider are missing.
mailing.encryptionActive: Encryption active: secrets are stored encrypted.
mailing.encryptionKeyMissing: Set MEMSHIP_SECRET_KEY to store provider secrets.
mailing.encryptionKeyRequired: Secrets cannot be saved without an encryption key.

emailTemplates.title: Member emails
emailTemplates.description: Which emails the system sends out. These control email only — in-app notifications and the portal are unaffected, and a member who has opted out of email never receives any of them. Account-access emails cannot be switched off.

groupDescriptions.auth: Sent when someone activates an account or recovers a password. Always on — there is no other way in.
groupDescriptions.members: Sent when an admin approves or rejects a sign-up request.
groupDescriptions.activities: Sent when a member's place in an activity changes — confirmed, waitlisted, cancelled, or promoted off the waitlist.
groupDescriptions.bookings: Sent when a member's booking of a space changes — confirmed, waitlisted, cancelled by the club, or promoted off the waitlist.
groupDescriptions.billing: Sent when a receipt is issued or falls overdue, plus the internal summary of each billing run.
groupDescriptions.broadcasts: Email delivery of announcements. Switch it off and announcements still appear in the app — they just stop going out by email.

featureOff.communications: The announcements module is switched off above, so nothing is sent either way.

verification.name: Email verification
verification.locked: Without this email a new account cannot be activated.

password_reset.name: Password reset
password_reset.locked: The only way to recover access to an account.

registration_approved.name: Registration approved
registration_approved.description: Tells the member their registration was approved and they can log in.
registration_approved.warning: The member has no other signal that their registration was approved.

registration_rejected.name: Registration rejected
registration_rejected.description: Tells the applicant their registration was not accepted.

registration_confirmed.name: Registration confirmed
registration_confirmed.description: Confirms a registration for an activity.

registration_waitlisted.name: Registration waitlisted
registration_waitlisted.description: Says the registration went onto the waitlist.

waitlist_promoted.name: Activity place freed up
waitlist_promoted.description: Tells the member they moved off the activity waitlist.
waitlist_promoted.warning: The member gained a place and must act on it. Without the email they will not turn up.

booking_confirmation.name: Booking confirmed
booking_confirmation.description: Confirms a booking of a space.

booking_waitlisted.name: Booking waitlisted
booking_waitlisted.description: Says the booking went onto the waitlist.

booking_promoted.name: Booking place freed up
booking_promoted.description: Tells the member their booking is now confirmed.
booking_promoted.warning: The member gained a place and must act on it. Without the email they will not turn up.

booking_cancelled.name: Booking cancelled by the club
booking_cancelled.description: Tells the member the club cancelled their booking.
booking_cancelled.warning: The member will turn up for a booking that no longer exists.

receipt_delivery.name: Receipt delivery
receipt_delivery.description: Sends the receipt PDF to the member when it is issued.
receipt_delivery.warning: Members stop receiving their receipts by email.

payment_reminder.name: Payment reminder
payment_reminder.description: Chases overdue receipts on the configured schedule.
payment_reminder.warning: Overdue receipts stop being chased by email.

billing_summary.name: Billing summary
billing_summary.description: Internal summary of each billing run, to the admin address.

announcement.name: Announcements
announcement.description: Delivery of the announcements admins broadcast.
